Standard Chartered launches institutional BTC/ETH spot trading in the UAE –
Link
Standard Chartered became the first global systemically important bank to offer deliverable BTC and ETH spot trading to institutional clients in the UAE. The service extends a launch the bank first rolled out in the UK in July 2025.
Matters because: It adds more mainstream banking infrastructure for institutional crypto flow and legitimacy in the region.
